name: Get segment contact count
description: Call this when you need the total number of contacts that match a segment query without retrieving the full list. Use the "List contacts in segment" action instead if you need the actual contact data.

fe_query.description: Front‑end query object defining filter criteria for contacts.

searchBy.description: Optional search string to further filter contacts; can be empty.

contact_count.description: Number of contacts returned in the current response page.

total_count.description: Total number of contacts that match the query.
